# CodeDAC

> CodeDAC is an independent developer of small utility apps for Android and Windows — floating tools that stay on top of other apps (notes, timers, calculator, crypto ticker, reading guide, clipboard), plus auto start, volume boost and on-device photo redaction. Every app is free to download with an optional Pro upgrade; pages are available in 21 languages.

## Android apps (Google Play)

- [Clipboard+](https://codedac.com/apps/clipboard.html): Clipboard history & manager. Copy, save, search and paste on phone or PC. Key features: Every copied text and image kept in a searchable history, newest first; Resizable floating overlay for use over any app; Organize frequent text into snippets and groups; Instant search and filter by keyword, text, image, or date; Fast paste from a home screen widget and the notification panel, and save from any app via the text selection menu; Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive, export clipboard history to PDF, plus backup and restore. Free vs Pro: Free keeps your text and image clipboard history with search, snippets, up to 3 groups, the floating panel, the widget and the selection-menu shortcut, and it shows ads. Pro removes the ads and adds phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive, unlimited image clips, the expanded floating panel and widget, unlimited groups, PDF export and backup restore — monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. If you need one of these for just a day, a short ad unlocks it for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.clipboard
- [AutoStart+](https://codedac.com/apps/autostart.html): Auto-launch your apps on boot. No root required, set once. Key features: Auto starts your selected apps after every reboot, as soon as you unlock the phone — no root, no custom ROM; Car Mode for head units: your apps open again every time the screen wakes from sleep — free; Drag the rows to decide which app starts first at every boot; Run now from any row's ⋮ menu — check your list without rebooting the phone; After a reboot, a banner starts your whole list in one tap as soon as you unlock the phone (PRO); Free auto starts 1 app; PRO lifts the limit, or a short ad unlocks it for 24 hours. Free vs Pro: The free version starts 1 app per boot. PRO removes the limit, so the whole list launches in the order you set. If you'd rather not subscribe, watching a short ad unlocks the limit for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.autostart
- [FloatCalc+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcalc.html): A floating calculator with FX and unit converters, on top of any app. Key features: Floats over any app — YouTube, maps, browser, banking, shopping, documents — and reopens in the mode you used last; One-tap operator row: + − × ÷ ( ) % right above the built-in number pad, with backspace to fix a single typo; Powers, roots and percentages — 2^10, √144, 100+10% — and the expression stays on screen after “=”, so a tap brings it back to edit; Unit converter inside the window: length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and time; Currency converter with daily ECB rates for 30+ currencies; Settings shows the date of the last update and its source; Fold the keypad down to one line or shrink the panel to an icon docked at the screen edge, with adjustable size, width, opacity and 8 themes. Free vs Pro: The floating calculator is free for 60 minutes a day, and the panel's title bar shows how much of that is left. When you need more, watch a short ad for a 24-hour pass. Pro removes the daily time limit and the ads and adds the remaining unit categories and 30+ currencies, 7 premium themes and full panel customization (opacity, size, width), monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatcalc
- [FloatCrypto+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcrypto.html): A live crypto ticker floating over any app, with alerts and charts. Key features: Floating price ticker on top of every app — drag it anywhere, resize it, dial the opacity down; Price alerts on an upper or lower target, added straight from the coin card with the coin filled in; Watchlist of the coins you care about, with live price, 24-hour change and drag-to-reorder; 1-day / 7-day / 30-day charts with period high, low, open and change; Eastern and Western color modes — green-up/red-down, or red-up/blue-down as read in Korea, Japan and China; Binance prices with an automatic fallback source, delayed by up to 30 seconds (10 on Pro). Free vs Pro: Free follows 2 coins with 1 price alert and refreshes the ticker every 30 seconds. A Free Pass opens one feature for 24 hours in exchange for one short ad — the Chart pass unlocks the 7-day and 30-day charts, the Watchlist pass gives 10 coins and unlimited alerts — one of each per day, for as many days as you like, and ads keep running while a pass is active. Pro gives 10 coins, unlimited alerts, a 10-second refresh, the full chart history and no ads, monthly, annually or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatcrypto
- [FloatTimer+](https://codedac.com/apps/floattimer.html): A floating timer, counter and stopwatch that stays over any app. Key features: Floating overlay — timers, counters, and stopwatches float on any app; drag them anywhere and set size, opacity, and background color per item; Multi-timer — any hours/minutes/seconds countdown, with 1, 5, 10, 25, 30 and 60-minute quick presets and as many timers running at once as you like; Overlay controls — play, pause, and reset from the overlay menu without opening the app, or collapse it to a bubble marked with the app icon and tap anywhere on it to open it again; Tally counter — tap to count up or down right on the overlay, with a step of 1, 2, 5, or 10 and as many counters as you need; Stopwatch — several stopwatches, each timed separately; start, pause, and reset without leaving your current app; Alerts and backup — sound, vibration, or a full-screen alert when time is up, plus file export and restore that merges or replaces. Free vs Pro: Unlimited timers, counters, and stopwatches, with no daily time limit. The only free limit is one floating overlay at a time — Pro shows as many as you like at once, or you can watch a short ad for a 24-hour Free Pass. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floattimer
- [VolumeBooster+](https://codedac.com/apps/volumebooster.html): Volume booster, equalizer and bass boost — make any sound louder, up to +15 dB. Key features: System-wide boost up to +15 dB with Safe / Caution / Danger labels — +10 dB free, the full range with Pro or a Free Pass; Loudness Maximizer with multiband compression, makeup gain and an always-on peak limiter — genuinely louder, with no clipping or distortion; 5-band Equalizer with 9 presets, all free: Flat, Pop, Rock, Vocal, Classical, EDM, Movie, Gaming and Night Mode; Bass Booster, 3D Virtualizer and AutoEQ — 2,456 measured headphone profiles across 357 brands, with mainstream brands (Apple, Samsung, Sony, Bose, JBL, Beats) free; Floating Panel free for everyone, plus hearing protection stats (Pro), a sleep timer with fade-out, L/R channel balance, a Quick Settings tile, a home-screen widget and notification controls; Free Pass — one short ad for 24 hours of Max Boost or AutoEQ; otherwise free boosting runs 60 minutes a day and resets at midnight. Free vs Pro: Free gives you up to +10 dB, all 9 presets, the 5-band equalizer, the floating panel and AutoEQ for mainstream brands like Apple, Samsung, Sony, Bose, JBL and Beats — with free boosting limited to 60 minutes a day, resetting at midnight. A Free Pass adds 24 hours of Max Boost (the full +15 dB range with no daily limit) or AutoEQ (the complete headphone catalogue) for a single short ad, with no card and no trial to cancel. Pro unlocks the full range, unlimited boost time, every AutoEQ profile and the hearing protection dashboard, and removes ads — monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.volumebooster
- [PhotoCleaner+](https://codedac.com/apps/photocleaner.html): Hide personal info in photos & PDFs, fully on-device. Key features: Solid opaque mask that can't be recovered (not a blur or mosaic); Draw masks by hand, then move, resize or delete them, with zoom for precision; Built-in detection suggests likely sensitive text (ID numbers, cards, phones, emails) — free and unlimited, as a starting point you review; Mask photos, ID cards and multi-page PDF documents; Zero permissions, an EXIF & GPS notice, and every saved or shared copy re-encoded with no EXIF; No watermark for anyone: 3 exports a day on free, unlimited with Pro along with PDF export and printing — or a short ad opens either for 24 hours. Free vs Pro: Three times a day. What counts is the Export button, whatever you do with the result: save, share, PDF or print. Detection, editing and masking are never capped. Pro removes the daily limit, and if you'd rather not subscribe, a short ad lifts it for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.photocleaner
- [ReadFocus+](https://codedac.com/apps/readfocus.html): A dyslexia & ADHD reading aid with line highlight & mask. Key features: Line Highlight (Reading Ruler): illuminates your current line to keep eyes on track; Reading Mask: dims everything except your reading zone for tunnel-vision focus; Fully adjustable focus strip: height (50dp–300dp) and opacity (10%–100%); 10 color themes (3 free + 7 Pro); Works on top of any app — ebooks, PDF, webtoons, news, research papers; Pro: ad-free experience, unlimited overlay time, and keep screen on while reading. Free vs Pro: Yes. The free version gives 60 minutes of overlay time per session and 3 color themes. Pro adds an ad-free experience, all 10 themes, and unlimited overlay time — and you can also watch a short rewarded ad to unlock any Pro feature free for 24 hours. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.readfocus
- [FloatNote+](https://codedac.com/apps/floatnote.html): Sticky notes that float over any app. Collapse to a chip, expand to a card, with colors and rich text. Key features: Floating overlay notes: collapse a note to a chip, expand it to a full card over any app; 7 sticky-note colors and rich text: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text color and size; Inline images (Pro): attach photos right inside a note; Quick capture from the share sheet, from selected text in any app, or from the Quick Settings tile; Library with instant search, pinning and drag-to-reorder — dragging a chip to the bottom zone stashes the note instead of deleting it; Pro: unlimited floating notes, inline images, adjustable opacity, Google Drive sync, export & import, no ads. Free vs Pro: Yes. Saving notes is unlimited and free, and the free version floats one note at a time, gives you all 7 colors and shows ads. Pro adds unlimited floating notes, inline images, adjustable opacity, Google Drive sync, export and import, and removes ads. Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.codedac.floatnote

## Windows apps (Microsoft Store)

- [Clipboard+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/clipboardwin.html): A Windows tray clipboard manager that syncs with the Clipboard+ Android app. Key features: Sits in the tray and saves text and images the moment you copy them — it never has to keep checking in the background, so it stays light; Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive; Android-style UI with light/dark themes, group sidebar, snippets, and pin/copy/edit/search; Multi-select bulk move, delete, and merge, newest/oldest sorting, and a full-size image viewer; Quick-pick popup at the cursor on a global hotkey, plus hotkeys to open the window and capture text selected in other apps, and run-at-startup; Export/import compatible with the Android Clipboard+ backup format, plus PDF export. Free vs Pro: The clipboard history, snippets and groups, search, the quick-pick popup, and the light and dark themes are all free. Pro adds Google Drive sync, copying image clips back to the clipboard, PDF export, backup import, unlimited groups, and unlimited image storage — free image storage is capped at 50 MB. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N9SRKQV1R6D
- [ReadFocus+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/readfocuswin.html): A click-through focus strip for Windows — Mask and Highlight keep your eyes on the line. Key features: Two reading modes — Mask dims everything outside a clear band, Highlight marks the line you are on; Click-through: keep scrolling, selecting and clicking the app underneath — nothing intercepts your mouse; A floating panel to switch mode, move or lock the strip and hide it, collapsing to a single row when you do not need it; Keyboard shortcuts for start and stop, mode, show and hide, lock, and nudging the strip up or down; Multi-monitor: the reading band follows the panel to whichever screen you move it to, and waits in the system tray until you need it; No ads. Pro is a one-time purchase: premium themes, Focus Strip settings, Keep Screen On, and no time limit. Free vs Pro: Yes. The free version reads in sessions of up to 60 minutes and includes both reading modes and three of the ten themes. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds premium themes, Focus Strip settings (height, opacity) and Keep Screen On, and removes the time limit. The Windows version has no ads. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMSHKKX3R5C
- [FloatNote+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floatnotewin.html): Sticky notes that float over any window on Windows, syncing with the FloatNote+ Android app. Key features: Sticky notes that float above every window: a chip expands into an editable card in place, and Esc folds it back; Never steals focus — drag or click a chip and your cursor stays in the app you were typing in; No save button: every keystroke is committed for you, and a library window handles search, pinning and management; Rich text — bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, text color and size — with 7 pastel note colors and inline images; Bidirectional phone-to-PC sync through your own Google Drive — the same app-private folder the Android app uses, and never a CodeDAC server; Global hotkeys, system tray, light and dark themes, run at logon, 21 languages. No ads, and Pro is a one-time purchase. Free vs Pro: Yes. Writing and storing notes is free and unlimited, and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one note on screen at a time, with all seven colors. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating notes, inline images, adjustable note transparency, Google Drive sync, and note export and import. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NW6610397TC
- [FloatTimer+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floattimerwin.html): Timers, counters and stopwatches that float over any window on Windows as small pastel cards. Key features: Timers, counters and stopwatches float above every window as small pastel cards — drag one anywhere, resize it, or collapse it to a bubble marked with the app icon; Never steals focus — click or drag a card and your cursor stays in the document you were typing in; Start, pause and reset from the card itself without opening the app; counters add and subtract with a click on either half; Nine pastel colors, adjustable card size and opacity, and app windows that follow your light or dark theme; The backup file is the same format as the Android app, so you can export on one and restore on the other; Global hotkeys, system tray, run at logon, 21 languages. No account, no network, no ads — and Pro is a one-time purchase. Free vs Pro: Yes. You can make as many timers, counters and stopwatches as you like — the list is never limited — and the Windows version has no ads. The free version floats one card on screen at a time. Pro is a one-time purchase — not a subscription — and adds unlimited floating cards, repeating timers, any color you like, and your own alert sound or a full-screen alert. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P3CTX3SXTGW
- [PhotoCleaner+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/photocleanerwin.html): Hide personal info in photos, screenshots and PDFs on your PC before you share. Key features: Finds phone numbers, emails, card numbers, IBAN, passport numbers and MRZ, Korean IDs, names, addresses, license plates, faces and QR codes; Review every box before export: click to toggle, drag to move, drag an edge to resize, draw your own, Undo any step; Open photos, screenshots and PDFs by drag and drop, Ctrl+V, or right-click "Clean with PhotoCleaner+" in File Explorer; Solid, opaque masks — not a blur — and no watermark; Save as JPEG or PNG, Copy, Share, Save PDF and Print; Saved copies carry no EXIF, GPS location or other metadata, and your original is never overwritten; Fully on your PC: no account, no upload, no recent-files list. Light and dark theme, 21 languages. Free vs Pro: Finding personal info is free and unlimited, and you can save, copy or share the masked copy of 3 documents a day for free. Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the daily limit and adds PDF export, printing, the always-hide list and your choice of mask color. There are no ads and no watermark, on either version. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P22XH3N66VM
- [FloatCrypto+ for Windows](https://codedac.com/apps/floatcryptowin.html): A live crypto price ticker that floats over every window on Windows, with price alerts and charts. Key features: A live price ticker on top of every window — drag it anywhere, adjust opacity and text size, or collapse it into a bubble at the screen edge; Never steals focus — the ticker stays visible while your cursor stays in the app you are working in; Price alerts above or below a target, one-time or repeating, added straight from a coin's ⋮ menu with the coin already picked; Watchlist from the hundreds of Binance pairs, drag-to-reorder, and 1-day, 7-day and 30-day charts with period high, low, open and change; Western (green up, red down) or Eastern (red up, blue down) colors, and a full price table on the tray icon; Global hotkeys, system tray, start with Windows, light and dark themes, 21 languages. No ads, no account. Free vs Pro: Free follows 2 coins with 1 price alert, refreshes every 30 seconds and shows the 1-day chart — and the ticker has no time limit. Pro is a one-time purchase that raises this to 10 coins, unlimited alerts, a 10-second refresh and the 7-day and 30-day charts. The Windows version has no ads. Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMFCT755G24
